Validate joint PNR accuracy and repair shared Gaussian click sampling

Generate32768 fresh PNR records with audited disjoint domains and quantify two-port photon counts without rank truncation. Implement shared Gaussian click constraints, repair a measured quadmath SSE rounding leak, replay fifteen failures, and retain full512-record approximation-bias evidence. Archive serial four/64-record timing comparisons and all failed diagnostic versions.

Validation: 266506 final independent checks; 1011 tests run, 982 successful, zero failures/errors; ten new tests. Full-law quality and general superiority remain open research work.
